questions.prompt: Which chart type is best for showing the distribution of a single numeric variable?
questions.explanation: Histograms display frequency of numeric ranges, making them ideal for distribution analysis.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is NOT a good practice when labeling axes?
questions.explanation: Abbreviations can reduce clarity and may confuse viewers.

questions.prompt: Which chart type is best for comparing parts of a whole across categories?
questions.explanation: Stacked bars show how each category contributes to the whole.

questions.prompt: A researcher wants to show trend over time for multiple categories. Which chart is most appropriate?
questions.explanation: Line charts excel at displaying time trends across multiple series.

questions.prompt: A dataset contains outliers that could distort a bar chart's appearance. What technique can mitigate this?
questions.explanation: A logarithmic scale compresses large values, reducing the impact of outliers.

questions.prompt: When designing a heatmap, which design choice ensures honest representation of data?

options.text: Use a diverging color scheme for data centered around zero
Use a single color ramp for all values

questions.explanation: A diverging scheme highlights deviations from a central value, improving interpretability.
